original_evidence.text: | Qt Creator | qt-creator/qt-creator (UpdateInfo plugin) + code.qt.io/installer-framework/installer-framework (external "Maintenance Tool") | native C++/Qt; delegates entirely to the separate Qt Installer Framework (QtIFW) "Maintenance Tool" binary | Y | check: automatic, on a configurable interval (default weekly, first check 1 min after startup — `updateinfoplugin.cpp`); download/install: manual — user must click "Start Update" or "Start Package Manager", which launches the external MaintenanceTool | Y, but entirely inside the separate MaintenanceTool (QtIFW) process — qt-creator itself only spawns it via `QProcess`/`Process::startDetached` with args (`ch`, `se`, `--updater`, `--start-package-manager`) and parses its XML/text output; qt-creator's own source contains no network download code | Repository URL scheme (`http://`/`https://`) is vendor-configured, not restricted in code; in `installer-framework`'s `downloadfiletask.cpp:345-353`, `onSslErrors()` only **logs** SSL errors via `qCWarning` and never calls `reply->ignoreSslErrors()`, so Qt's default behavior (abort on cert failure) applies — no explicit TLS bypass found | N — `Updates.xml` repository manifest integrity is protected only by an *optional* SHA1 checksum (`Repository::xmlChecksum()`, `<Checksum>` element), not a cryptographic signature | hash-from-manifest: SHA1 checksums for `Updates.xml` and each extracted package file (`metadatajob.cpp:781-789,620-624,891-956`); no code-signing/PKI signature verification of packages found anywhere in the public `installer-framework` source | N/A (plain SHA1 embedded in the same over-the-wire XML manifest it's meant to protect, not an independent trust anchor) | `qt-creator/src/plugins/updateinfo/updateinfoplugin.cpp:365-424` (spawns `MaintenanceTool ch/se`, parses output), `:747-760` (`startUpdater()`/`startPackageManager()` launch MaintenanceTool detached); `installer-framework/src/libs/installer/metadatajob.cpp:781-789` (SHA1 checksum mismatch check for Updates.xml); `installer-framework/src/libs/installer/downloadfiletask.cpp:345-353` (`onSslErrors` logs only) |
